shortDescription: FRESENIUS MEDICAL CARE AG XETR:FME:Further company coverage:

children: SAID ON TUESDAY IT IS INVESTIGATING A CYBERSECURITY INCIDENT INVOLVING UNAUTHORIZED ACCESS TO A LIMITED NUMBER OF INTERNAL SYSTEMS
INCIDENT HAS NOT IMPACTED OUR MEDICAL DEVICES, PATIENT CARE, MANUFACTURING OPERATIONS, OR BUSINESS CONTINUITY
UPON DISCOVERY, WE IMMEDIATELY TOOK STEPS TO CONTAIN AND ADDRESS THE SITUATION
WE HAVE ENGAGED LEADING CYBERSECURITY EXPERTS AND NOTIFIED LAW ENFORCEMENT AS PART OF OUR RESPONSE
